test: USB-UART boot capture + reboot of MYIR Z-Turn (XC7Z020, PynqLinux 2.4 / Ubuntu 18.04)

uart.adapter: Silicon Labs CP210x USB to UART Bridge

capture_validation.note: validate.log captured live 'xilinx@pynq:~$' prompt before any reboot; capture path proven.

reboot.method: single SSH command: sync; reboot (root@192.168.2.99 via key id_zturn)
reboot.trigger_delivery_evidence: shutdown sequence appeared on UART ~8 s after trigger; post-boot uptime = 1 min
reboot.reboot_cmd_exit_code_note: ssh connection drops when the board reboots; the -1 is the dropped session, not a failure to reboot.

boot_checklist.fsbl: not printed to this UART (FSBL stage silent); first PS output is U-Boot
boot_checklist.u_boot: U-Boot 2018.01 (Nov 13 2019), Board Xilinx Zynq, Silicon v3.1, DRAM 1 GiB (ECC disabled)
boot_checklist.sd_detected: mmc@e0100000: SD32G 29 GiB, SD v3.0, High Capacity
boot_checklist.kernel_load: image.ub FIT read (4173540 B), kernel@0 hash OK, Linux 4.14.0-xilinx
boot_checklist.device_tree_load: fdt@0 (14904 B) hash OK, 'xlnx,zynq-7000'; zynq device is 7z020
boot_checklist.rootfs_mount: EXT4 /dev/mmcblk0p2 mounted; VFS mounted root (ext4) on 179:2
boot_checklist.pynqlinux_up: systemd 237; 'Welcome to PynqLinux, based on Ubuntu 18.04!'
boot_checklist.login_prompt: 'PYNQ Linux ... pynq ttyPS0' -> 'pynq login: xilinx (automatic login)'

anomalies_non_fatal: U-Boot: '*** Warning - bad CRC, using default environment' (QSPI env not written; cosmetic, boots from default env)
kernel: 'genirq: Flags mismatch irq 47' + 'uio_pdrv_genirq uio@0: unable to register uio device ... -16' (no PL bitstream at boot; PYNQ loads the overlay at runtime, harmless for this flow)
kernel: 'hctosys: unable to open rtc device (rtc0)' and 'System time before build time' (no battery-backed RTC; expected)
systemd: "Failed to insert module 'autofs4'" (module absent; cosmetic)

errors_fatal.notes: No panic, no ext4 errors, no failed critical units observed through login.

connectivity_after_boot.ssh: connected with key id_zturn; uptime 1 min; /proc/uptime ~70 s (confirms fresh reboot)

safety: No SD flash/format; no boot/network config changed. Existing fpga_fulltest_* artifacts untouched.
